label_basis: Observable changed behavior under policy.json, not the target CVE class. Required routes are minimum obligations; optional routes are defensible interpretations needing adjudication. Labels cover the supplied diff, not an entire historical PR. Freeze this file before each experiment.

cases.rationale: Adding IPatientCompartmentResourceService changes the patient-scoping contract even though this is a fix. A privacy owner is defensible for the patient-data access contract.
New SearchConfigClauseBuilder builds ORDER BY from configured field names and pagination clauses.

FHIR CareTeam changes patient search parameters and patient/provider resource serialization. Route the access contract even without detecting the missing compartment interface. Uses the repaired study diff.
Static help heading change with no dynamic construction or sensitive data behavior. This is a constructed control, not an observed CVE.

The complete payment diff adds a request-selected getPortalAuditRec access path, changes patient-data queries and dynamic output, and emits gateway_api_key into JavaScript. The new record access path requires boundary-owner review independently of the target secret-exposure CVE.
Removes a redundant result-presence wrapper and static empty-state wording. Does not change dynamic output expressions or query construction. Correctness questions are separate from security routing.
Changes callback login gating and response handling. Login response contents are outside the diff, so sensitive-data review and output-construction review are defensible.
Disables TLS peer and hostname verification. Constructed policy-coverage fixture, not evidence from the CVE corpus.
Introduces XMLReader parsing with XInclude and PARSEHUGE flags. Treating these parser flags as security configuration is also defensible.
A safe query-field whitelist still changes SQL construction and needs its designated PR reviewer.
Complete fax-controller diff changes authenticate, document delivery/readfile, outbound email attachments, SQL and HTML generation. Uses the repaired study diff.
Converts a DOM string flag to an integer for local amount arithmetic. The payment filename alone does not establish a changed data boundary.

Changes document byte retrieval and return behavior, including an early return before the encryption branch. Access-path, dynamic-output and cryptographic-flow review are defensible additions. The caller is absent, so this does not claim the cross-file XSS is visible.
Changes auth.inc session-expiration enforcement and removes the timeout iframe. Session configuration and changed JavaScript/iframe construction are defensible secondary routes.
